reason: The current sampled-softmax run reaches macro HR@10 of 0.4437 versus the original BCE baseline's 0.505, with Electronics falling from 0.420 to 0.305; architectural differences prevent attributing this gap solely to the objective. Independent logistic supervision tests whether coupling positive gradients to sampled competitors limits generalization. Historical objective replacements show mixed outcomes, while successful reduction experiments support carefully controlled comparisons, so preserve the architecture and sampling and change only the objective specification and its training-loop implementation.

plan.model_design: Replace sampled-softmax cross-entropy with independent binary logistic supervision: each example contributes softplus(-positive_score) plus the mean softplus(valid_negative_scores), followed by an equal-weight batch mean. This isolates the initial hypothesis that independent supervision improves sparse-item learning; historical failures of sampled-softmax replacements motivate this test without establishing that logistic loss will win, and historical recency-weighting successes do not justify adding another modification here. Preserve HistoryModel and all constructor, contextualize, encode, score, forward, and predict signatures, tied input_emb/output_emb parameters, item_bias, learned scale, architecture, dropout, and scoring function. Introduce no recency weighting, hard-negative weighting, auxiliary scorer, or additional independently trained predictor.
